requirements.description: Gate hwlp_we_i[2:0] with valid_i, store halfword-aligned [31:1] start/end addresses, saturate zero counters on decrement, and resolve simultaneous nested end-of-loop decrement (hwlp_dec_cnt_i == 2'b11).

Preserve apu_lat against ungranted requests while active, retire only waiting when both slots are active, and drain flushed in-flight APU slots without asserting apu_rvalid_wb_o or register dependencies.

Constrain fpu_rm_in->fpu_rm_out (1.10 ns internal budget) and hart_ctrl_in->hart_ctrl_out (1.85 ns internal budget) under 3.25 ns input and 2.75 ns output delays across 8 ns and 10 ns clocks without excepting registered ports.
